# leaseweb_object_storage_user (Resource)

Manage an object storage user

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Manage an object storage user
resource "leaseweb_object_storage_user" "backup_agent" {
  object_storage_id = "5c9d2a1e-3b47-4f8d-9e21-7a6c8b0d4f33"
  full_name         = "Backup agent"
  unique_name       = "backup-agent"
  groups            = [leaseweb_object_storage_group.readonly.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `full_name` (String) Full name of the user
- `groups` (Set of String) IDs of the groups the user belongs to
- `object_storage_id` (String) ID of the object storage the user belongs to
- `unique_name` (String) Unique name identifier for the user

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) User ID

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A user can be imported by specifying the object storage ID and the user ID in comma-separated format.
terraform import leaseweb_object_storage_user.example "5c9d2a1e-3b47-4f8d-9e21-7a6c8b0d4f33,4e7a9d02-6f31-48b5-a0c9-1d2e8f4b7a56"
```
